tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gser chos lugs kyi lha mchog dmar po rnam gsum gyi bsang mchod cho ga sde bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i dbyar ring zhes bya ba bzhugs so// yid 'phrog phrin las grub pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs khengs ldan yid// brtan pa rang dbang 'gugs byed lhag pa'i lha// rnam gsum dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon gyis srungs// kun rtog ye shes klong song rnal 'byor pa'i// grogs su mi khug skye 'phags 'byor ldan su// khab len rten 'brel la brten lo ha'i khams// brtan pa rnam 'gyur can du bgyid pas mtshon// phyogs kun nyul ba'i dri zhim sprin rum nas// mchod rdzas gya nom spros pas lhag pa'i lha// rnam gsum dgyes zhal 'dzum du dmul dang mnyam// sde bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i bsang mchod brtsams// dpal sa skya'i gser chos kyi nang gsel dmar po skor gsum gyi lha tshogs la bsang mchod 'bul ba la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ lha gsum gyi rten bris 'bur gang rigs kyi mdun du/ nyer spyod dang gtor ma zlum gtor gsum mam gcig bsang rdzas phye mar shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba sogs spyi ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel ba'i tshe mi dgos kyang*/ 'di nyid sger btub byed na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi sogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang la/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥbadag nyid brtan g.yo'i bdag po lhag pa'i lha// snang stong sgyu ma'i rtse 'jo'i thugs ka nas// 'gugs byed 'od zer stong gi pho nya dag /glog 'gyu skad cig rnam pas phyogs su 'phros// ku ru kul+le'i phug dang bde ba can// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas sogs gar bzhugs nas// rigs byed dpa' mo 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi bdag /rnam gsum bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// nor lha'i 'khor bcas 'gro la phan gdags phyir// dam bcas rjes dgongs 'dir spyon sa ma dzaḥ/

bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kun gsal lus phra'i 'gram par dur khrod brgyad// khang bzangs zla gam sgo gcig mtshan nyid rdzogs// bai ḍūr+ya yi brag ri'i bsti gnas gsum// chu skyes 'od stong gdan la brtan par bzhugs// badz+rā san pra tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ gsal gdab pa ni/ hrīḥdabus phyogs dbugs bral gnas brgyad gdan gyi steng*// byi ru'i 'khri shing gzhon nu dri gzhon gyis// rnam pa g.yo 'dra'i yid 'phrog rigs byed ma// 'dod pa'i myos bum rgyas pa'i khur gyis mdzes// khro 'dzum spyan gsum g.yon phyogs zur lta bcas// chu skyes dmar por co 'dri'i phyag bzhis mdzes// dang pos ut+pal dmar po'i mda' gzhu 'gengs// tha gnyis dbang gi lcags kyu zhags pas brel// mi mgo skam rlon phreng dang stag sham gyis// lang tsho'i mdzes pa bsgribs pas ci bya zhes// rus pa'i rgyan lngas khrel snyam g.yon brkyang gi /gar stabs mi ro brdzis pa'i 'od stong 'bar// g.yas phyogs dbang gi gzhal med khang mdzes kyi// gdan la g.yon brkyangs dor stabs bzhugs pa'i lha// 'dod pa'i rgyal po pad+ma rā ga'i rir// nyi 'od gzhon nus 'khyud lta'i dmar mdangs 'tsher// skye 'gro dbang sdud lcags kyu phyag g.yas 'phyar// cig shos 'gro sems 'ching ba'i zhags pa bcang*// spyan gsum dmar glog smin ma'i nags 'dabs rtsen// dug can 'khyog por 'phye ba'i do shal byas// dbang gi dga' bde rgyas ma'i lang tsho'i dpal// rgya skyegs me tog dkyil nas phyung ltar dmar// lcags kyu bum pas lag brel g.yon bskum zhabs// byin pas thabs la 'khril tshul gnyis ka yang*// mtshams sprin gsar pa g.yo 'dra'i stod g.yogs dang*// tshon lnga'i sham thabs dbang po'i gzhu la 'phya// rin chen rgyan 'khrol thor tshugs spyi bor bcings// ye shes me 'od 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// gtso mo'i g.yon phyogs gsang bdag 'byung po 'dul// rngam stabs bzhugs pa'i 'og char brag ri'i khrod// chu skyes gdan steng dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// byi ba mnan pa'i dmar chen tshogs bdag dmar// gnyis 'thung gdong gi sna lag brkyangs pa'i khas// mche rnon shel gyi chu gri gdengs pa la// spyan gsum skrags pas rdzi ma stug po'i khrod// rings par bros nas hrig gis blta snyam byed// g.yas pa'i phyag drug dgra s+t+wa mda' bo che// lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri 'phang mdung dang*// g.yon drug gtun shing gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/thod khrag sha chen snod bcas phub mdung 'dzin// thor tshugs ral pa'i stod zil lhun po'i spor// nor bu'i tog gis nyin mor byed pa gsal// dar gyi sham bus 'ja' tshon la sdang zhes// rin chen rgyan tshogs gad mor dgod bzhin 'khrol// g.yon brkyang skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis// 'od zer dmar po 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhengs// gsum ka'i spyi bor pad+ma'i rigs mchog bcas// dmar 'od nyi zer 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs// bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras slob ma// mkha' 'gro nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gsal// bsang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsang gsum rang bzhin 'bru gsum gyis// mchod rdzas byin rlabs ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mchod yul dgyes bskyed mchod rdzas bsang rdzas tshogs// 'dod dgu phun tshogs bskal par gnas gyur cig /mchod yon chu gter rlabs kyis mkha' la 'khyud// zhabs bsil dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab// thang chur skyes pa'i me tog ci yang 'dzum// dri zhim sprin gyis zhing kun khyab pa'i spos// phyogs kyi mun 'phrog mar me lce brgya bskyod// reg par bde ster zhim pa'i dri chab rdzing*// ro drug bcud ldan zhal zas ri bo'i phreng*// 'gyur khugs snyan pa'i glur 'jo rol mo'i sgra// rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rtags// gser dngul nor bu gos dar bgo ba'i rigs// dkar mngar shing thog la du la phug dang*// 'bru sna phye mar ja chang bdud rtsi'i mtsho// yid bzang dbang po'i 'dod yon ma brkus shing*// 'khor sgyur bsod nams bza' thang ma bcad par// dri ro nus pa phun tshogs ba lin+taḥ// kha kha khā hi khā hi dgyes par rol// dbyar skyes rkang 'thung gzhon nu'i lcug phran rtser// me tog snye ma lo ma'i lding khang du// yid 'ong bsil yab g.yo ba spos kyi shing*// byin zar gtul ba dud pa'i sprin chen ni// nyes tshogs 'khrud pas gaṅgā'i chur dmod kyang*// ci 'dod yon tan 'byin pas dpag bsam shing*// co 'drir byed pa'i bsang mchod rgya chen 'dis// khams gsum 'gro ba dbang du sdud byed pa'i// bka' srol dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams bsang*// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha tshogs bsang*// khengs ldan yid 'phrog ku ru kul+le bsang*// dbang gi khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal po bsang*// bgegs rgyal lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po bsang*// dam tshig can la brtse zhing dbyig ster ba'i// mkha' 'gro nor sbyin 'khor tshogs thams cad bsang*// bsang mchod phul bas khyed cag dgyes rab rtser// nye bar son pa'i 'dzum brgya dmul mdzod cig

/nyes tshogs bshags pa ni/ kye tshe rabs kun du 'gro ba ma dad rgyur// gang dag bsags pa'i las sgrib mthol bshags na// 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma nongs dri bral gyi// 'dab stong grol ba'i ngo mtshar ltar ston cig /sgrub po'i dbang du 'gro tshogs 'dun tsam gyis// khyed cag thugs rje'i drin du mi bstod de// de kun gnas skabs mthar thug bde rgyur bcas// sbyor bar dngos grub ster ba 'dis kyang ngo*// 'dod don phrin las gsol ba ni/ kye sems can byang chub lam du mgron gnyer ba'i// dam bca'i yi ge snying la bkod pa bdag /dmar ba'i lha gsum mchod pas mnyes gyur nas// yid 'phrog phrin las dngos grub da ltar stsol// stobs 'byor che mtho 'khor ba'i phun tshogs dang*// mkhas btsun grub pa thar pa'i yon tan can// thams cad pad+ma'i bsung gis sbrang rtsi'i mgrin// ji bzhin bdag dbang dgug pa'i phrin las mdzod// brgyud pa'i rim pa las 'ongs gser chos kyi// gdams ngag bsgom bzlas rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas// sna tshogs las kyi pho nyas snod bcud kyi// dge legs mtha' dag rang dbang mchis par mdzod// dad can 'dus pa'i zhing sa gshin pa'i khrod// zab rgyas chos kyi sa bon rma med btab// thabs lam brtson pa'i myu gu bskyed bsrings rtser// byang chub mchog gi snye ma smin mdzod cig /rnam dpyod 'phong skyen 'jug pas gti mug gi /'bod grogs 'tsho ba mthar byas rig pa'i gzhung*// kun rig smin legs si tā khab bkug nas// mkhas tshul gsum gyi dga' ston 'gyed par mdzod// srid pa'i dpal 'byor la brten stobs bcu pa'i// bstan pa spel dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun bcas// dpag yas mchod pa'i phreng bas mchod bgyid cing*// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i spyod mtsho 'gengs mdzod cig /khab long gor ma'i nus pas lcags kyi phye// yid srubs 'jo sgeg 'phrul gyis 'dod ldan bzhin// bla ma yi dam nor lha'i thugs rje yis// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor tshur bsdus g.yang du stsol// gsum pa ni/

mchod yul mgron du gang dag byon pa rnams// mchod par sgyu ma'i gar gyis rnam rtsen zhing*// mchod pas dgyes tshul dngos grub legs stsal nas// mchod yul rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs su gsol// oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas bkra shis 'pho bral go 'phang brnyes// chos kyi bkra shis brjod bya rjod byed 'brel// dge 'dun bkra shis skyon bral yon tan rgyas// skyabs gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ 'dis mtshon dge ba'i mtshar sdug rkang pa'i rtses// 'gro snying mya ngan med par bsnun pa'i 'phral// dad gsum 'dab stong grol nas tshogs gnyis phyir// kun dga'i ge sar dgod pa'i rgyu phyir bsngo// ces so// 'dir smras pa/ phyogs kun sngo bsangs kyis khyab dbang po lnga'i// yul gyur 'dod yon spro zhing dpal 'jo ba'i// bsang mchod cho ga'i dbyar ring 'di yod bzhin// 'gyur ldog sprin sngon dus des ci zhig bya// 'di sbyar bsod nams mar gyur sems can gyi// bsam kun rdzogs pa'i yid bzhin nor phyir ram// byang chub snying po'i phyir ci shes bya'i yul// thams cad mkhyen rgyur bsngo yi gzhan phyir min// zhes gser chos lugs kyi lha mchog dmar po skor gsum du grags pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga sde bzhi'i dga' ston 'jo ba'i dbyar ring zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bcu phrag shes bya'i yul la mkhyen dpyod kyi 'od stong rab tu gsal ba'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku skal bzang phrin las lhun grub pa'i gsung bskul tam+bu ra'i rgyud las 'phos pa'i dbyangs snyan lta bus son par brten/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// lha bsang 'khyer bde mgron rigs dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs//

༄༅// bla ma dkon mchog gsum 'dus rin po che// tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs su gtsug bsten nas// srid las 'das dang srid pa'i mgron rigs rnams// bsang mchod 'bul ba'i cho ga 'khyer bde brtsam// de la bsang rdzas ci 'byor pa spyi ltar bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs sogs lan gsum/ spyan drang ba ni/ hrīḥbadag nyid lhar gsal snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// nyan thos bka' srung nor lhar bcas pa'i tshogs// spyan 'dren tshur gshegs gdan la brtan par bzhugs// mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsang mchod dngos rdzas stong pa'i ngang nyid las// ye shes rang snang ma 'gags 'dod pa dgu// mgron rigs dgyes bskyed rol pa'i chu gter che// 'dzad med longs spyod bskal par gnas gyur cig /bsang mchod 'bul ba ni/ kye khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas nyer spyod lnga// rin chen 'bru rigs ja chang phye mar phud// sman spos lha shing bsregs pa'i dri zhim sprin// 'dod yon mi zad spro ba'i mchod sprin 'dis// rdo rje 'chang dang grub brnyes brgyad cu bzhi// lam 'bras lam skor bla ma thams cad dang*// dgyes rdor bde mchog gsang 'dus 'jigs byed dang*// mkha' la spyod sogs yi dam lha tshogs bsang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang thub pa'i dbang*// rgyal sras sems dpa' gnas brtan bcu drug dang*// bstan srung gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring bsang*// dur khrod las kyi gshin rje dmag zor rgyal// beg tse lcam dral dkar bdud nor lha'i rigs// khyim sbra lam lha 'go ba'i lha srung dang*// yul phyogs 'dir gnas yul lha gzhi bdag bsang*// 'dod don gsol ba ni/ bsang mchod phul bas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nyes ltung dme yugs 'khon grib dag gyur nas// nad med ring 'tsho gnas skabs mthar thug don// gang brtsams thams cad gegs med 'grub par mdzod// bla ma rnams kyis bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// yi dam tshogs kyis thun mong mchog dngos stsol// bstan srung bar chad sel zhing phrin las sgrubs// nor sbyin rnams kyis dgos 'dod char bzhin phob// phyogs bcu'i chos srid dpal 'byor dar ba'i g.yang*// thams cad tshur bsdus phywa g.yang dngos grub stsol// gshegs su gsol ba ni/

bsang mgron dgyes te dngos grub stsol bzhin pas// gshed bzhud tshul yang ston cig badz+ra muḥ// bkra shis ni/ sangs rgyas bkra shis don gnyis lhun gyis grub// chos kyi bkra shis thog mtha' bar du dge /dge 'dun bkra shis skyon bral yon tan ldan// mchog gsum bkra shis des 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// zhes lha bsang 'khyer bde mgron rigs dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ par dpon tshul khrims ting 'dzin pa'i gsung gis mgron rigs dmigs bsal yod pa'i spyi bsang bsdus pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// spyi bsang 'don bsgrigs kyi tho chung yod// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ spyi bsang btang bar 'dod pas/ thog mar gser skyems btang na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum dang*/ ma hā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal hrīḥsogs nas/ ye shes ha ya grī ba nas/ gnas su dengs zhes pa'i bar brjod/ gal te gser skyems ma btang na'ang bsang gzhung la chad skyon ni ci yang med do// de nas bsang gzhung skye ba lnga pa kho nas rung ba ltar na/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa nas bzung ste/ mthar dge ba bsngo ba'i bar dkyus bzhin gzhung bsrang ba las gzhan ci yang mi dgos la/ bdag chen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i bsang dang sbrags te 'don pa'i tshe/ thog ma'i sngags drug phyag drug gser skyems kyi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ skye ba lnga pa nas 'byung ba gang rung gis bsang rdzas dang mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ dge legs dpal gyi sogs lan gsum dang*/ hrīḥbadag nyid rgyal ba zhes sogs kyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rjes su/ hrīḥrang gi snying ga las byung zhes pa nas/ rol ltar gshegs su gsol gyi bar ro// de nas bdag chen pa'i spyi bsang gi thugs rje tshad med sogs nas/

phrin las grub par mdzod kyi bar ro// de nas skye lnga'i nang gi kye mdun gyi sogs nas/ gdan la bzhugs su gsol gyi bar gyis mgron gsal gdab/ de rjes rgya gar ba'i/ na mo chos nyid sogs dang*/ kye de ring gnam la nas phrin bcol mjug gi smon lam 'grub gyur cig gi bar brjod/ slar yang bsang rdzas kha bsos la/ skye lnga'i nang gi oṃ bcom ldan sbyin pa'i zhes pa nas/ stobs su che mdzod cig ces pa'i bar ro// bar 'dir bsang brgya tshar bsag dgos yod na bsags pa'am rang rang gi yul ris gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod sogs gang dgos 'jug de nas phywa g.yang dgug pa'i bla ma yi dam zhes pa nas rgyas gyur cig gi bar dang*/ skye lnga'i nang gi kye g.yang du len no zhes pa nas/ bde legs shog gi bar dang*/ spro na bkra shis gang shes dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ rtag 'grus sogs nas/ spyod gyur cig ces pa'i bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo// zhes bdag rkyen rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i spyi bsang dang skye lnga sbags te 'don bsgrigs kyi tho chung 'di'ang tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
